test_title: PYST 03: SSC JE CE - General Intelligence (Held on 05 Jun 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Pillar E is to the east of Pillar D. Pillar A is to the west of Pillar D. Pillar B is to the north of Pillar A. Pillar C is to the south of Pillar A. Pillar E is to the south of F. Pillar G is to the South of E. What is the position of Pillar F with respect to Pillar C?
solution:
According to the given information,

1) Pillar E is to the east of Pillar D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a455581e3b9f502d2e3ec416cde03acc52fc1bdc5a1b8c11974da89ad867103a.png] 

2) Pillar A is to the west of Pillar D. Pillar B is to the north of Pillar A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b8f8692d657d14b62498e4a423f0c750b3d1101ec9753eb33f0b2f9630869c0.png] 

3) Pillar C is to the south of Pillar A. Pillar E is to the south of F. Pillar G is to the South of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7c6fd0ffee6c78177d565cf1ca36490f2df0b1d2b491b683d26298e5d8cea2dd.png] 

Here, we can see that Pillar F is in North - East direction with respect to Pillar C.

Hence, the correct answer is **"****North - East"**.
